notes: Fixed 2026-08-12: XML tokenizer now skips DOCTYPE and parses CDATA, so spine XHTML parses via the XML path instead of falling back to whole-document HTML text. Observed after fix: markdown_similarity 0.8861, content_recall 0.8973 (was 0.2881 / 0.1574). Threshold set to ~90% of the observed value.
